    CEP operator-algebra substrate #

    This file defines the shared C*-algebraic objects for an operator-algebraic attack on the failure of the Connes Embedding Problem.

    The summit target is the C*-native gap lemma: a finite synchronous nonlocal game whose game *-algebra has a tracial state but has no amenable, matrix-microstate-approximable tracial state. Such a gap separates C_qa from C_qc and gives the intended route to ¬ CEP.

    Mathlib substrate used here:

    • CStarAlgebra, CStarRing;
    • PositiveLinearMap and GNS;
    • IsStarProjection;
    • CStarMatrix;
    • VonNeumannAlgebra / WStarAlgebra;
    • Filter.Germ over an ultrafilter as the carrier substrate for matrix ultrapowers.

    Mathlib does not currently provide the bundled tracial state, C*-tensor products, game *-algebras, tracial von Neumann ultrapowers, or nonlocal-game correlation sets needed here, so they are introduced below as minimal non-vacuous definitions.

        structure ZFib.CEP.SyncGame (X Ans : Type u) [Fintype X] [Fintype Ans] [DecidableEq Ans] :
        Type u

        A finite synchronous nonlocal game.

        allowed x y a b = true means the answer pair (a,b) is accepted on question pair (x,y). The synchronous condition says equal questions force equal answers.

        • allowed : X → X → Ans → Ans → Bool
        • synchronous' (x : X) (a b : Ans) : self.allowed x x a b = true → a = b

                            structure ZFib.CEP.MatrixMicrostate {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (F : Finset A) (ε : ℝ) :
                            Type u

                            A finite matrix microstate for a tracial C*-algebra on a prescribed finite set.

                            The approximation is deliberately stated as data, not proved from any hidden completion theorem: it is a unital approximately star-preserving and approximately multiplicative map into a concrete matrix C*-algebra, reproducing the trace on F.

                                            theorem ZFib.CEP.L2Seminorm_zero {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (σ : TracialState A) :
                                            L2Seminorm σ 0 = 0

                                            Finite-dimensional C*-models have amenable traces.

                                            Analytically witnessed by a faithful finite-dimensional -representation into a matrix algebra, with the model trace transported to the normalized matrix trace; the current Mathlib substrate in this file does not yet expose that finite-dimensional representation theorem for bundled C-algebras, so the analytic construction is the remaining target.

                                            structure ZFib.CEP.FiniteDimCStarApproxMatrixModel (A : Type u) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (F : Finset A) (ε : ℝ) :
                                            Type u

                                            The finite-dimensional C*-algebra substrate, as data: a faithful unital -homomorphism of A into a single concrete matrix C-algebra whose tracial state reproduces τ on the prescribed finite set up to ε. Existence packages Artin–Wedderburn for finite-dimensional C*-algebras with rational-multiplicity approximation of the trace weights and block-diagonal amplification. The *-homomorphism is exact (so the multiplicative/star microstate errors vanish); only the trace is approximated on F.
